summary: Frontend-only verification of Live section for year 2026. Confirmed via Playwright on the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL that the 2026 header displays '4 eventi' and, on expansion, renders all 4 events with correct names and locations: CYPHA KINGS - Giuria contest con Mastafive (Bassano del Grappa), 10 ELEMENTS HIP HOP CAMP ZULU NATION - STRIKE THE HEAD lesson 'Tecniche di scrittura' (Bassano del Grappa), Cena sotto le stelle - ristorante Antefora - STRIKE THE HEAD DJ SET (Pralormo), and the pre-existing CSF Carmagnola Queen Car (Carmagnola). Bassano del Grappa appears exactly 2 times as expected. Text is rendered in uppercase via CSS but underlying content matches source data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live section renders events grouped by year with data-testid='live-year-{year}' buttons. Note that event and location text is displayed in uppercase via CSS class 'uppercase' / tracking-widest, so string assertions in tests must be case-insensitive or use uppercase variants.
